description: You need the person's answer before you can go on. Ask one clear question, with the context it needs to be answered without opening your terminal. You keep what you hold and nobody else can take it. Then STOP and tell the user you are waiting: do not carry on guessing. When they have replied, call take with this id and their reply comes back with it. Use `pass` instead when the work is not yours. When the answer is a choice between options, offer them as `choices` so the person can pick one with a tap.

choices.description: when the answer is a pick between options (two layouts, three fixes): two to four, each with a screenshot when it is something to look at. The person picks one in the hub with a tap; their pick comes back as the reply

detail.description: one line more: what it means or costs

label.description: what this option is, in a few words

picture.description: a screenshot of it, uploaded with add_file first: the /v1/shots/ link

cwd.description: the worktree you are working in; default is the server's cwd

question.description: one clear question in the first person, a few sentences at most, plain text: "Should the dark-mode toggle live in Settings or the header? The header is crowded on mobile." What you were about to do, if they just say yes, helps

name: ask
title: Ask the person
